# Vendored QuickJS

Upstream: https://bellard.org/quickjs/
Snapshot: quickjs-2026-06-04
Source archive: https://bellard.org/quickjs/quickjs-2026-06-04.tar.xz

The exact downloaded archive SHA-256 is recorded in QUICKJS_SHA256.
QuickJS is MIT licensed; see QUICKJS_LICENSE and quickjs/LICENSE.

This package compiles the vendored C sources directly. It does not depend on a
third-party React Native QuickJS wrapper or a separately installed QuickJS
library.
